description.value: The Wickaninnish Inn is a celebrated boutique hotel perched at the edge of Chesterman Beach between ancient rainforests and the Pacific Ocean, and a member of the prestigious Relais & Châteaux collection. The inn features multiple on-site dining venues including The Pointe Restaurant, On the Rocks Bar, and a seasonal Driftwood Café, as well as the Ancient Cedars Spa and an art gallery. Its location adjacent to Pacific Rim National Park Reserve makes it a compelling base for cyclists exploring Tofino's beaches and trails.
